title: Say the Action
user: People with limited keyboard/mouse access who need a small, trustworthy voice-command layer for a few repeatable browser or coding actions.
smallest_useful_product: Browser extension with on-device speech recognition where available, a visible command palette, 10 user-approved DOM actions per site, and a confirmation step for submit/delete/navigation.
success_measure: At least 70% of pilot users successfully perform five configured actions by voice with no unintended destructive action over one week.
constraints: Never present it as a replacement for platform accessibility tools
